Row Grain: One federal election contest ingested into the warehouse
Purpose: Stores contest-level metadata used to identify year, office/chamber, electoral method, seat count, and term length.
Notes: Includes presidential, deputies, and senate contests when available. For the current ingested additions: 1994 presidential only; 2000 and 2006 presidential/deputies/senate; 2015 and 2021 deputies only.

Row Grain: One normalized geography combination used by at least one casilla
Purpose: Stores the geographic keys that can be consistently joined from casilla-level results, even when source cycles expose different geographic detail.
Notes: The warehouse keeps nullable municipality, district-head, and circunscripcion fields because not every source cycle contains them. 1994 and 2006 include municipality text; 2000 and 2015 do not; 2021 maps district name into cabecera_distrital_federal.

Row Grain: One casilla or acta within one election contest
Purpose: Stores polling-station or acta identifiers and operational attributes needed to link facts to geography and distinguish repeated casilla labels.
Notes: The primary key is composite because a casilla identifier can repeat across elections. acta_casilla_mec is populated from the best available source key: synthesized casilla_id in 1994/2000/2006/2015, and CLAVE_ACTA in 2021.

Row Grain: One normalized party or coalition vote option
Purpose: Stores the vote-option domain used by fact_casilla_vote after wide party columns are converted to long format.
Notes: party_key can represent a single party, coalition, independent candidate option, or source-era coalition label. members records coalition membership when known.

Row Grain: One candidate/catalog row for a party or coalition in a state-district-election type
Purpose: Stores candidate catalog information available for cycles with candidate reference files.
Notes: Loaded from dim_candidatos.parquet when available. Present for 2015 and 2021 in the current ingested additions; 1994/2000/2006 did not have candidate catalogs in the ingestion.

Row Grain: One vote total for one party_key in one casilla and election
Purpose: Stores normalized long-format vote results, one row per election-casilla-party option.
Key Foreign Keys: election_id -> dim_election.election_id; party_key -> dim_party.party_key; election_id+casilla_id -> dim_casilla
Notes: UNIQUE(election_id, casilla_id, party_key) prevents duplicate vote-option rows. Total, null, non-registered, and valid-vote columns are nullable because source cycles report different aggregate fields.
